facilitator-modular-record.unama/S2: Norway said the new mandate would have UNAMA promote inclusive political dialogue, monitor and report on human rights, facilitate humanitarian assistance, and engage all Afghan actors including the Taliban.
facilitator-modular-record.unama/S3: Russia stressed the host country's agreement to UN presence was vital, noted opposition to its reference during drafting, argued for substantive Taliban cooperation, and warned that omitting it could impair UNAMA's effectiveness.
facilitator-modular-record.unama/S4: China welcomed the renewal and urged the country concerned to expedite the unconditional return of Afghan assets to the Afghan people, while expressing doubts about the resolution's priorities and calling for timely review and potential adjustment.
facilitator-modular-record.emergency/S2: Brazil voted in favour despite reservations on timing and peace contributions, stressing urgency warrants the General Assembly's voice and that the Council must exhaust instruments for a negotiated solution.
facilitator-modular-record.emergency/S3: Nebenzia, speaking for Russia, recorded a negative vote objecting to the draft recording the Council's inability to uphold its primary responsibility, distinguishing it from Russia's prior veto of draft S/2022/155.
facilitator-modular-record.emergency/S4: India called for an immediate end to violence, advocated diplomacy, welcomed border talks, highlighted stranded nationals, demanded uninterrupted movement, and emphasized predictable crossings.
